## Astraeus 2.9.1: The Heads-Up Update

Hey everyone!

This one is all about Astraeus telling you things before you have to go looking. It reminds you of your next meeting and gets you into the call, shows which app is using your mic or camera, follows your downloads as they come in, and finally lets you search Settings. Oh, and you can now just say it to save a clip. Enjoy!

### New Content

**Live Pills**
- Added meeting reminders. Five minutes before an event on your calendar, a banner shows what's coming up, with a **Join** button when it has a Teams, Zoom, Meet or Webex link.
- Added a pill when an app starts using your microphone or camera, plus a small dot on the island for as long as it does: green for the camera, orange for the microphone.
- Added live downloads. While Chrome, Edge or Firefox downloads something, a pill shows its name, size and speed. When it's done, click the pill to see the file in its folder.
- Added a **Live pills** card in Settings to switch each of these off.

**Clips**
- Added **Say a phrase to save a clip** on the Games page. Say **"Astra clip that"** while a game records and the clip is saved, just like the shortcut. It's heard on your PC only.
- "Astra" always comes first, and the two words after it are yours to pick.
- Added **Size** and **Turn** to the Clip Studio: zoom in on the action, or tilt the picture.

**Tools**
- Added the **Night light**, **HDR**, **Mobile hotspot** and **Nearby sharing** tiles. HDR only shows up when a screen supports it, and the hotspot only when your PC can share its connection.

**Long Pill**
- Added **Bluetooth battery**, which shows your connected devices' battery, lowest first.

**Settings**
- Added search. Click **Search** at the top of Settings or press **Ctrl+F**, type a few letters, and pick a result to jump straight to it.
- Added a full-screen **What's new** after every update, whether you updated by hand or Astraeus did it on its own. You can open it again from **Settings › Updates**.

### Quality of Life
- A game you add from its file is now named after its window, not its file.
- Clip pictures in the Clip Studio now load faster.
- The volume and brightness pill is no longer experimental.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed Astraeus not telling you it had updated when it updated itself in the background.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
